title: Seas The Day on 30A's Santa Rosa Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Seas the Day is more than a name—it’s an invitation to embrace the easy rhythm of coastal life, where mornings begin with sea breezes and every day is made for memory-making. This thoughtfully designed 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home in Santa Rosa Beach
description_expanded: Seas the Day is more than a name—it’s an invitation to embrace the easy rhythm of coastal life, where mornings begin with sea breezes and every day is made for memory-making. This thoughtfully designed 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home in Santa Rosa Beach sleeps up to 14 and welcomes multi-generational families, friend groups, and anyone craving connection and comfort near the Gulf. Just a 5–7 minute walk to the beach, this quiet corner of 30A feels like a hidden gem—close to everything, yet peacefully tucked away. The private 14x20 pool is a favorite among guests of all ages, whether it’s cannonballs with the kids or a quiet evening swim beneath the stars. A classic front porch with rocking chairs and a swing invites slow starts and long conversations, while the upstairs screened balcony offers a tranquil perch above the pool. Step inside to discover light-filled living spaces wrapped in crisp white walls, coastal accents, and warm wood floors. The open layout is made for togetherness, from cozy movie nights in the living room to pancake breakfasts around the cottage-style dining table. The kitchen is a standout with its large quartz island, stainless steel appliances, and playful chrome orb lighting—equally perfect for prepping family meals or hosting happy hour. A main-level queen suite with private bath gives added convenience, and nearby, you’ll find a laundry room and powder bath, all designed for easy, beach-going days. Upstairs, the primary suite is a serene retreat with a king bed, spa-like ensuite, and screened balcony access—ideal for morning coffee or a good book at golden hour. Two additional queen bedrooms and a playful bunk room with four twin beds ensure everyone has their own cozy space. Every bedroom includes a flatscreen TV, and thoughtful touches throughout the home create an atmosphere that’s both elevated and effortlessly welcoming. Families rave about the location: a short stroll to Gulfview Heights beach access with restrooms, showers, and a shaded pavilion, plus walkability to beloved local spots like Local Catch , Shunk Gulley , and Pecan Jacks ice cream. Gulf Place is just two minutes away, with live music, art markets, shops, and casual dining. The nearby towns of Seaside , Alys Beach , and R osemary Beach offer postcard-worthy day trips, while Destin’s harbor and attractions are a quick drive west. And when you're ready to come home, this peaceful neighborhood offers a quiet exhale at the end of each sun-drenched day. Whether you’re gathered around the table, chasing little ones in the pool, or walking back from dinner with sandy feet and happy hearts, Seas the Day delivers what so many guests have already discovered—a place that feels like home, only better. First Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom, Bonus Room with Twin Bunk and Twin Trundle. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
